relationship_invariants.definition: At each postscan sample: M11 cannot coexist with a normal frequency; if M0=0 or mode invalid, M0/M11/D120/D154/Y0/D8050/D8051 all 0. If M11=1 then M0=1, D120=D154=Y0=D8050=0. If M0=1 and M11=0 then 2000<=D154<=5000. Invalid D322 always implies stopped vector that same scan.
enabled := D323==1 and M0==1 and D154>0. Y0=int(enabled); D8050=(D154*4)//5 if enabled else 0; D8051=0. Evaluate on each final scan image, including transitions, never endpoint-only.

If D322 in{0,1}, raw = D330 if1 else (D331 if D332==1 else D8030); expectedPV=(clamp(signed16(raw),0,4000)+12)//25; D100==expectedPV, D308==D100. D102=clamp(D324,10,160); D309==D102. External request/input words persist unless explicitly written, except first-scan defaults (D325 invalid replaced 60, D326=floor(D325*85/100), D327=100, D328=30, D329=2000).

Observe actual M8012 input image on every scan, including boot. Rising edge iff current1 and previous0; do not assume50ms phase (environment correction: initial high may begin t0). Track independent A starting0. Stop/pre-sleep/sleep force A0 and frequency respectively0/2000/0. Entering normal from stopped/pre-sleep/sleep sets A0,f2000; skip PI on transition scan, and update only on a subsequent rising edge. On eligible rising edge, e=D102-D100; A=clamp(A+e,0,30000); increment=clamp(10*e+A//10,0,3000); f=2000+increment. All other normal scans hold previous A,f even if input or SV changes. Assert D120==A and D154==f every scan. Read frozen requirements and this recurrence only; never execute/translate S2 source to obtain expected values.

Independently accumulate continuous running-not-sleeping PV>=D260 duration, reset on any below-threshold scan/stop/invalid. Sleep transition permitted only elapsed4900..5100ms (scan timestamp uncertainty<=10ms), requires pre-sleep first. In sleep track continuous PV<=D262; reset on any above-threshold scan/stop/invalid. Wake transition permitted only elapsed2900..3100ms. Sleep must persist in dead band. A transition MUST occur by upper bound if continuously qualifying. Track both timers afresh for every cycle; include one-scan cancellations. Qualification uses current clamped settings. Detect wake event even when SV10 means wake/pre thresholds overlap; do not demand durable normal state at overlapping thresholds.

Measure first D154==5000 relative to first started normal scan; 39800<=elapsed<=40200ms. Throughout uninterrupted PV0 normal operation D120,D154 never decrease; A never exceeds30000, frequency never exceeds5000; by50.2s A30000 and f5000. Low-pressure normal run cannot enter sleep/pre-sleep.

From second observed postscan sample, signed16(D306_current-D306_previous)==1, including32767->-32768. Heartbeat D305 must change at100ms intervals (allow10ms timestamp quantization; no assumed numeric increment or initial value); no interval>110ms after initial startup. D317 equals externally supplied D333 on the next executed scan. D300=5,D301=31,D304=5 on every sample; D302/D303 remain stable.

S3 independently obtains final instruction list excluding dedicated BEGIN_IDENTITY/END_IDENTITY block; normalize exactly documented canonical algorithm supplied by S2, hash SHA256 and decode first4 bytes as two little-endian uint16 then signed16. Compare observed D200/D201 to those values and externally record full source/test hashes. Require specification-compatible canonicalization; do not merely call/trust S2 fingerprint checker. No fingerprint value known to S1 because S2 has not started. Hardware identity must be read and match BEFORE any test writes; mismatch TEST_INFRA_ERROR, not PROGRAM_FAIL.

Only signed word1 on either start source asserts start; only signed word1 on either stop source asserts stop. Start sources: D320, D334. Stop sources: D321, D335. Stop wins even with start held1 on any source; start latches run after every start source is released. Invalid mode clears run and latches restart inhibit. Inhibit clears only after a valid-mode scan observes D320=0 and D334=0; a subsequent start from either source can then begin. D320/D334 zero observed only during invalid mode does not clear inhibit. Valid-mode recovery while either start source remains1 must stay stopped. Stop and sleep outputs clear in the same applied scan. Do not use implementation state flags as oracle inputs.

First scan M8196=M8125=1,D8120=signed16(0xE081)=-8063,D8121=1. S3 must verify static unknown instruction/address detection and independently run deliberate unsupported-instruction/address fixtures against the execution tool (not this candidate) to prove BLOCKED/UNSUPPORTED, never silent NOP. Missing serial observation or parser/engine capability is UNVERIFIED/TEST_INFRA_ERROR, cannot be called PASS. Physical serial protocol remains separate from register-image initialization.

Status block mirrors settle every executed scan: D308==D100, D309==D102, D311==D154, D312==D8050, D313=0, D318==D110, D319==D120, D310==clamp(D326,0,160), and D307 bits0/1/4/5 equal M0/M11/(D322==1)/(D323==1); bits2/3 are implementation-observed and not asserted here (mask 0x33).

oracle_contract.all_relationship_invariants: MUST; missing implementation/observation yields UNVERIFIED and blocks SIM_PASS
oracle_contract.trace: Full postscan trace plus applied external input image and actual M8012 per scan; preserve transition order/timestamps. Dictionary endpoints alone are insufficient.
oracle_contract.hardware: bench labels permit only frozen bench write whitelist; all initial_words need isolated CPU initialization or verified reset. Hardware polling does not prove scan-level oracles, exact100ms tick counts, or one-scan outputs. Mark these assertions UNVERIFIED unless equivalent proven event capture exists. local_only ADC cases must never write physical ADC registers.
oracle_contract.scope: Logic/register bench only; electrical AO and sensors/pumps, real power-loss retention, GX checks remain unverified/not executed.
oracle_contract.timing_phase: Observe M8012; initial phase explicitly not frozen. Equal100ms intervals used for exact endpoints span one edge; first20ms after10ms boot is before next new rising edge under corrected initial-high environment.
